newsitem.title: USA: Atchison Casting purchases Jahn Foundry.
newsitem.headline: Atchison Casting purchases Jahn Foundry.

text.p: Atchison Casting Corp said Friday it purchased Jahn Foundry Corp, a Springfield, Mass. producer of gray iron castings for customers in industrial and automotive markets.

"The market for automotive castings is important, and one in which ACC has not previously participated," said Hugh Aiken, Atchison Casting chief executive, in a statement. "This exciting first step in automotive castings will further diversify our market position, and open up a new avenue for growth."
Atchison Casting produces iron, steel and non-ferrous castings for equipment, capital goods and consumer markets.
Shares of Atchison Casting were trading up 3/8 to 20-1/4.
